description: Lucent.exe --export-batch <folder> --include-subfolders --to <new folder> --preset jpeg|tiff [--automatic auto] --measure --quit-when-done, new library each run: the folder is imported and fingerprinted (submission_s), then the batch runs through lucent-worker.exe processes (seconds: created to finished; per_minute: exported photos per minute). Scheduler figures are the batch service's own (peak_aggregate_commit_mib: the workers together, Job Object accounting); resources are sampled every 250 ms. Each report is checked against the files (report_check).
